feature.summary: Tabs switch panels, accordions open and close stacked sections, and disclosure toggles show one block of detail. Web, mobile and Chrome have tab lists; web and mobile expose expanded state on toggles. The CLI uses a tab strip in two screens and Ctrl-O to expand tool output.

purpose.what_it_does: Organises dense content: tabs for views (Sources and Report), expandable steps in a plan, and Show or Hide for thinking text and tool detail.
purpose.why_it_exists: Chat output can be long. Collapsing detail keeps the conversation readable and the state must reach assistive technology (doc: knowledge-base/data/area-briefs/008-basic-interactive-elements.md S8.31 to S8.33).
purpose.who_uses_it: Every user reading answers, research and agent steps.
problems_solved: Walls of detail in the transcript.
Screen reader users not knowing whether a section is open.
Keyboard users unable to move between tabs.
use_cases: Switch between Sources and Report in the web research panel.
Expand a plan step in the web StepsCard.
Switch plugin tabs in the CLI with Left and Right.

where_to_find_it: Web: research panel tablist 'Research views' with tabs Sources and Report (apps/web/features/chat/components/research/ResearchPanel.tsx:403-440); steps list with expandable rows (apps/web/features/chat/components/cards/StepsCard.tsx:186-260); button 'Toggle thinking process visibility' (apps/web/features/chat/components/messages/MessageBubble.tsx:3478-3490).

Desktop: public Electron window shows hosted web (doc: AGENTS.md section 5); retained Tauri code has its own tab pieces such as apps/desktop/src/ui/Tabs.tsx and role=tablist in apps/desktop/src/features/agi/AgentTaskPanel.tsx:73.

Mobile: project tabs with role tab (apps/mobile/app/(app)/projects/[id].tsx:245-275); agent activity steps (AgentActivityTimeline.tsx:417-422); 'Show fewer sources' toggle (CollapsibleSources.tsx:693-695).

CLI: plugin tabs Discover, Installed, Marketplaces, Errors with Left and Right (apps/cli/src/tui/widgets/screen_renderers.rs:590-663); agents tabs Agents, Running, Library (screen_renderers.rs:275-292); Ctrl-O expands or collapses tool output (apps/cli/src/tui/tui_app.rs:4056-4066).
VS Code: tablist 'Session source' with Local and Cloud (apps/extension-vscode/src/features/sidebar-webview/webviewContent.ts:3036-3038); toggles with aria-expanded.
prerequisites: Some content to show: thinking steps exist only when the message has thinking steps (MessageBubble.tsx:3476).
screens_and_controls: Web tab buttons role=tab with aria-selected inside role=tablist (ResearchPanel.tsx:403-413).
Web step toggle: button with aria-expanded inside a Radix collapsible (StepsCard.tsx:229-236).
Mobile tabs: role tab with selected state (projects/[id].tsx:258-261).
CLI tab strip: active tab shown in brackets on the agents screen (screen_renderers.rs:275-292).
journey: See the tab row or the toggle.
Click or press a key to switch or expand.
Content for that tab or block appears; the control's selected or expanded state changes.
feedback_and_outputs: Chevron icons flip between right and down (StepsCard.tsx:243-249; MessageBubble.tsx:3484-3488).
Mobile hint reads 'Shows the details of this step' or 'Hides the details of this step' (AgentActivityTimeline.tsx:419-421).
CLI status notice 'showing full tool output, Ctrl-O to collapse' (tui_app.rs:4060).
settings: None found for tabs and disclosure; web reduced motion or density settings were not checked.

working: Web research tabs set role tab and aria-selected (ResearchPanel.tsx:403-413).
Shared Tabs primitive wraps Radix tabs (packages/ui/ui/src/primitives/Tabs.tsx:1-63) and is used in several web screens, for example ArtifactPreview.tsx and AgentEditorPage.tsx.
Shared useTablistKeyboard hook gives ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down, Home and End (packages/ui/ui/src/primitives/useTablistKeyboard.ts:5-56).
Web StepsCard uses a collapsible with aria-expanded (StepsCard.tsx:229-236) and a progress label '% complete' (line 177).
Mobile steps and sources toggles expose expanded state (AgentActivityTimeline.tsx:422; CollapsibleSources.tsx:695).
CLI tabs move with Right/Tab and Left/Shift-Tab (screen_renderers.rs:658-665).
Chrome and VS Code expose a tablist role (side_panel.ts:13489; webviewContent.ts:3036).
incomplete: Web ResearchPanel tabs set aria-selected but the file does not use the arrow-key hook or tab panels (ResearchPanel.tsx has no ArrowRight or useTablistKeyboard match), so keyboard moves rely on Tab. The hook is used only in marketing CodeTabs among the apps searched (apps/web/features/marketing/components/system/CodeTabs.tsx).
VS Code session toggle: whether arrow keys work was not checked.
No accordion primitive exists; accordion behaviour is built from the Collapsible primitive per screen (packages/ui/ui/src/primitives/Collapsible.tsx:1-9).
not_available: Accordion in the CLI, VS Code and Chrome: brief says missing and no accordion was found in the files read.

established.statement: Tabs are a tablist switching panels with the selected tab exposed.
An accordion is a stack of sections that expand and collapse, each with a labelled header.
A disclosure control toggles one block of detail and exposes its expanded state.

acceptance_criteria: On web, the research panel exposes a tablist named 'Research views' and the active tab has aria-selected true.
With focus on a shared Tabs tab, Right Arrow moves to the next tab and Home moves to the first.
On web, the Thinking process button reports aria-expanded false then true after a click.
On mobile, an agent step with details announces expanded or collapsed.
In the CLI plugin screen, Right changes tab and Left goes back, wrapping at the ends.
In the CLI, Ctrl-O toggles full tool output and shows a status notice.
inferred: Tab lists should support arrow keys everywhere (WAI-ARIA pattern) [inferred; the shared hook exists for it].
proposed: [proposed] Use useTablistKeyboard in ResearchPanel and other hand-built tablists.
[proposed] Decide if a shared Accordion primitive is wanted or keep Collapsible and mark accordion n/a on CLI, VS Code, Chrome.

steps.what_happens: Person clicks or presses a key on a tab or toggle.
Local component state flips (selected tab or open flag) and the view re-renders.
CLI toggles a process-wide flag and redraws.

data.where_stored: Component memory only; persistence was not found

execution_and_data_flow.models_and_providers: None. Thinking text shown by the toggle comes from a model's reasoning output, but the toggle itself does not call a model.

access_and_usage.local_mode: Works fully on the device in Local mode; no network is involved.
